# Estimize API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Authentication
Cookie-based (session) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Data Read (16)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data for a specific Estimize resource.
- `GET /a/api/fastlane.json` — Retrieve fastlane configuration data.
- `GET /adx/usersyncsupply` — Retrieve user sync information for AdX supply.
- `GET /api/identity/envelope` — Get identity envelope information.
- `GET /api/sync` — Retrieve synchronized data from Estimize.
- `GET /cgi-bin/{cgi-binId}` — Retrieve data from a CGI script.
- `GET /cs/usersync.php` — Retrieve user synchronization information.
- `GET /dsp/api/sync/send` — Request a user synchronization from a DSP.
- `GET /jwumXNuB/v1/` — Retrieve data from an unknown endpoint.
- `GET /prebid/setuid` — Retrieve or set a user ID for Prebid.
- `GET /registration/pfp/evalidator.php` — Validate a profile picture during registration.
- `GET /sync/{syncId}` — Retrieve specific synchronization data.
- `GET /user-sync/{user-syncId}` — Retrieve specific user synchronization data.
- `GET /user/sync/pubmatic` — Synchronize user data with Pubmatic.
- `GET /usersync/{usersyncId}` — Retrieve specific user synchronization data.
- `GET /v1/api/sync/{syncId}` — Retrieve specific synchronization data.

### Data Write (16)
- `POST /{id}` — Update or create a specific Estimize resource.
- `POST /{id}/v1` — Submit data to a specific Estimize endpoint.
- `POST /6/map` — Map external IDs to internal Estimize IDs.
- `POST /a/c` — Submit data to an unknown endpoint.
- `POST /bid/bidder/investingchannel` — Submit a bid to InvestingChannel's bidder.
- `POST /c/hb/bid` — Submit a bid in a header bidding auction.
- `POST /e/dtb/bid` — Submit a bid for a DTB auction.
- `POST /header/auction` — Start a header bidding auction.
- `POST /openrtb_2_5/pbjs/auction/request` — Request an auction via Prebid.js.
- `POST /openrtb/pbjs` — Submit a bid using OpenRTB via PBJS.
- `POST /openrtbb/prebidjs` — Submit a bid using OpenRTB via Prebid.js.
- `POST /prebid/multi/{multiHash}` — Submit multiple prebid requests.
- `POST /rtb/prebid` — Submit a prebid request using RTB.
- `POST /ut/v3/prebid` — Submit a prebid request.
- `POST /v1/openrtb` — Submit a bid using the OpenRTB protocol.
- `POST /v1/sites/{siteId}/ortb` — Submit OpenRTB bid requests for a site.

### Media (1)
- `GET /images/variants/{variantId}` — Retrieve a specific image variant.

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /intake/v2/rum/events` — Send real user monitoring (RUM) events.

### Config (1)
- `GET /cdn/prod/config` — Get the Estimize application configuration.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Estimize's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Estimize data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.estimize.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Estimize frontend uses
